name: PANGS
source:
You are awake. It feels as though you have been asleep for a long time. You do not know where you are or even who you are. You are only sure of one thing: you are hungry.

PANGS (you are hungry.) is a short interactive story with 5+ possible endings.

[From [url=https://stardust-soda.itch.io/pangs-you-are-hungry]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒了。感觉就像睡了很长时间一样。你不知道自己在哪里，甚至不知道自己是谁。你只确定一件事：你饿了。

PANGS（你饿了。）是一个简短的互动故事，有5个以上可能的结局。

[来自[url=https://stardust-soda.itch.io/pangs-you-are-hungry]itch.io[/url]]
